verdict: MEDIUM risk overall; no auth bypass, no unapproved/duplicate-claim path, no secret leak found in the new v2 code. One conditional HIGH on outcome classification (pre-existing outcome.py) must be fixed or explicitly accepted before live.
attacks_run: ~230 scripted checks outside the repo against the harness + MemoryInstructionStore (auth/forgery/refs/commands/replay/same-cycle, state machine, caps, beneficiary change, hold, injection, images, self-loop, leakage, preflight, DoS) and the real PgInstructionStore on a scratch PG16 (217 repo store/migration/pg-cycle tests pass; 5x races of 8 approvals / 8 claims / 2 finalizes / daily-cap 4x15000, 3x20000, 25000+25000+0.01 / cancel-vs-claim all exact). Scratch PG removed.

findings.severity: high (conditional on real Investec 200 shape, unverified until G2 sandbox)
findings.issue: After the POST has been sent, a 200 body that is not the expected shape (no data object, no TransferResponses) or whose data.ErrorMessage is an EMPTY STRING is classified 'failed'; execute._failed then finalizes failed with release=True: the daily-cap reservation is freed and the user is told it failed although money may have moved. 'failed' is not in DUPLICATE_GUARD_STATUSES, so a re-instruction is not blocked => possible duplicate payment and cap bypass. Entry-level ErrorMessage already treats blank as no error (strip() != ''), data-level uses 'is not None' (line 120). Contradicts the executor's own rule that anything not positively 'not sent' is needs_review.
findings.fix: Treat blank/whitespace data.ErrorMessage as absent; map unrecognised_shape (no data / no entries) to needs_review (keep reservation, no release) rather than failed; keep 'failed' only for definite 4xx PaymentRejected or an explicit non-empty provider error. Add tests for ErrorMessage '' on success and for body {} / {'error':..}.
findings.repro: Env(live=True); to_batch; approve; e.client.responder=lambda:{'data':{'TransferResponses':[{'PaymentReferenceNumber':'PR1','Status':'Processed'}],'ErrorMessage':''}} ; cycle -> status=failed, daily_total 0.00, 1 POST made. Same for responder returning None or {'error':'x'}.

findings.issue: Currency words after a labelled/marked amount are ignored: 'Amount: 100 USD', 'R100 EUR', 'R100 per month' and 'Amount: R100 ... USD 50' all become ZAR 100.00. Needs batch approval and the batch email shows ZAR, so it is a human-visible mis-parse, not an auto-pay.
findings.fix: Reject (park currency_conflict) when a non-ZAR currency token (USD/EUR/GBP/$/dollars) sits adjacent to or in the same line as the marked amount.
findings.repro:
env.instruct('pay 123
Payee: Acme Trading
Amount: 100 USD
'); cycle -> awaiting_approval amount 100.00 ZAR.

findings.issue: sanitize_provider_message only redacts tokens of 24+ chars and 6+ digit runs; 'Bearer abc.def.ghi', 'key-77777', 'tok_SECRET99' echoed by a provider error survive into payment_instruction.outcome_message and the problem email (account numbers are redacted).
findings.fix: Also redact 'Bearer <anything>', 'key|token|secret|password\s*[:=]?\s*\S+' patterns; or store only a code and omit provider text from email.
findings.repro: responder returns {'data':{'ErrorMessage':'Account 1234567890 rejected Bearer abc.def.ghi key-77777'}} -> row.outcome_message keeps 'Bearer abc.def.ghi key-77777'.

findings.issue: PAYMENTS_HOLD_HOURS=1e308 (finite, so accepted by config._hold_hours and v2_settings) makes timedelta(hours=...) raise OverflowError in cfg.hold: each new-instruction message errors out and _beneficiary_sweep raises, aborting the whole cycle (incl. execution of approved items) every run. Fails closed but is a config-induced DoS; unparsable/negative/nan/inf correctly fall back to 24h.
findings.fix: Clamp hold_hours (e.g. > 24*365 -> 24*365 or fallback 24h) in both config._hold_hours and v2_settings.
findings.repro: make_settings(payments_hold_hours=1e308); cycle with an instruction -> results {'error':1}.

findings.issue: mailbox_not_dedicated only rejects '' and exact 'inbox' (case-insensitive). 'INBOX.', 'INBOX/', '"INBOX"' or IMAP-equivalent spellings pass preflight. Also the v2 reader fetches UNSEEN and marks mail read, so pointing at a shared mailbox consumes the user's mail.
findings.fix: Reject any mailbox whose normalised name (strip quotes/trailing delimiters) starts with or equals 'inbox'; or require an explicit PAYMENTS_MAILBOX_OK allow-list.

findings.issue: If the very first beneficiary fetch returns an empty list [] (not an exception), bootstrap is marked done with zero 'established' beneficiaries, so later-appearing existing payees count as newly seen and are held for PAYMENTS_HOLD_HOURS (when >0) and an empty list yields a 'new payee' paste email rather than a park. Fail-safe (extra delay/extra email to the verified owner only), no payment risk.
findings.fix: Do not mark bootstrap done on an empty list (or require >=1 beneficiary), and treat a persistently empty list as beneficiary_list_unavailable.

findings.issue: scrub_message secret-name pattern omits 'passphrase' (settings.backup_passphrase) and imap/smtp user names; only reachable if an exception text embeds them (none observed). Also a reply with NO quoted text is never confident, so cannot approve (fail-closed usability note).
